bullets.id: Emas spot ditutup Senin di sekitar $4.137,80, turun 0,63%, setelah sempat di $4.159,70 pada pagi hari waktu AS. Selasa pagi emas di sekitar $4.139, turun tipis 0,04% dan menuju penurunan hari ketiga beruntun menurut Trading Economics, tertekan dolar yang lebih kuat dan yield yang naik.
bullets.en: Spot gold closed Monday near $4,137.80, down 0.63%, after trading at $4,159.70 in the US morning. On Tuesday morning gold was near $4,139, down 0.04% and headed for a third straight daily decline according to Trading Economics, weighed down by a firmer dollar and rising yields.

bullets.id: Yield Treasury 10 tahun naik ke sekitar 5,14% dari sekitar 5,08% pada Senin pagi. Fed diperkirakan menahan suku bunga pada rapat 27–28 Oktober, tetapi pasar memperkirakan peluang kenaikan Desember sekitar 94%, naik dari sekitar 89%. Brent masih di sekitar $107–$110. Emas turun sekitar 4,7% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.14% from about 5.08% on Monday morning. The Fed is expected to hold at its October 27–28 meeting, but markets price about a 94% chance of a December hike, up from about 89%. Brent remains around $107–$110. Gold is down about 4.7% on the month and about 26% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Emas sudah di bawah support Kitco $4.150,72 dan $4.142,03; target turun berikutnya $4.118,63 lalu $4.066,71. Resistance di $4.170,55 dan $4.193,95. Agenda: housing starts (Selasa), klaim pengangguran (Kamis), survei aktivitas bisnis awal dan sentimen konsumen final (Jumat), lalu rapat Fed 27–28 Oktober.
bullets.en: Gold is already below Kitco’s $4,150.72 and $4,142.03 supports; the next downside targets are $4,118.63, then $4,066.71. Resistance is at $4,170.55 and $4,193.95. Agenda: housing starts (Tuesday), jobless claims (Thursday), preliminary business activity surveys and final consumer sentiment (Friday), then the October 27–28 Fed meeting.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp10.000 ke Rp2.564.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.379.000 (spread sekitar 7,2%). Galeri24 naik ke Rp2.526.000 (buyback Rp2.380.000, spread sekitar 5,8%) dan UBS ke Rp2.551.000 (buyback Rp2.354.000, spread sekitar 7,7%). Secara struktural, kepemilikan ETF emas bertahan di atas 101 juta ons, dekat puncak tahun ini.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp10,000 to Rp2,564,000/gram with a Rp2,379,000 buyback (spread about 7.2%). Galeri24 rose to Rp2,526,000 (buyback Rp2,380,000, spread about 5.8%) and UBS to Rp2,551,000 (buyback Rp2,354,000, spread about 7.7%). Structurally, gold ETF holdings stay above 101 million ounces, near this year’s peak.
